<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/page-link/"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the subscription's current customer-facing page link without rotating it, so a link already in the customer's hands keeps working.

The create response has no `page_url`. Call this endpoint at any time after creation, with no need to wait for the first payment. Ottu emails and texts the customer when the subscription is created, when the first payment completes, and when you regenerate the link; these messages carry the self-service link. To send the link at any other time, read it here instead of regenerating it.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/page-link/' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY'"}</pre>
